items.title: Jean Bach interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, October 18, 1995
items.q: They flew Chubby and his wife, Chubby Jackson and his wife... in from California.

ctx.x: Life Magazine has re-staged the photo, and then done a new photo for 50 years from now I guess.

Well who knows? I mean already we’re thinking of people that should have been added and that it’s going to happen. The poor guy who did it. He’s been a basket case all summer long. First he wanted to line up all the people who were in the movie, who are still alive, who were gettable. And the only one that escaped his grasp was Sonny Rollins, who’s in Japan and couldn’t get out. But they flew in from Italy they flew Gerry and Franca Mulligan in from Italy. items.title: Chubby Jackson interviewed by Monk Rowe, San Diego, California, February 14, 1998
items.q: a lady by the name of Jean Bach put this whole thing together, a lovely lady, too

ctx.x: Yeah. Because all these guys were in that photo. And that wasn’t called “Great Day in Harlem.” And a lady by the name of Jean Bach put this whole thing together, a lovely lady, too, and whoever was available — I mean Woody was not there because he was out of town, Lionel wasn’t there, Duke wasn’t there. But if you see that picture, I have a little picture of that with me—
